scenarios.purpose: A normal foreground Supervisor batch accepts its tasks, persists a completed RunManifest and exposes a clean status checkpoint.
A wide nested worker process group is captured, cleaned and persisted with exact POSIX identities and bounded residual evidence.
commands: cleans more than 16 external groups with a 512-member group

scenarios.purpose: Deadline extension, timeout and late-result evidence stay correct under mapped activity. This deliberately includes the observed in-flight checkpoint flake so repetition outcomes stay visible.
commands: (the same child timer|collect waits for an in-flight grant checkpoint)

scenarios.purpose: A SIGKILLed controller's persisted top-level and nested worker groups recover through exact identities, never through process-name matching.
commands: recovers a controller-death fixture's 512-member nested group

scenarios.purpose: WorkspaceBoundary detects out-of-write-path changes after a wave and rejects the affected task while preserving bounded evidence instead of deleting it. This is guard-only detection, not write prevention.
A fresh process reads only a terminal RunManifest/EvidenceBundle fixture and reconstructs the next legal action. This simulates context loss and does not claim provider-level compaction equivalence.
commands: (a fresh process reconstructs|blocked retryable state resumes|an EvidenceBundle fixture is re-decided)
